connector.name: Sidearm
connector.registryDescription: Protect media from AI training, detect AI-generated content, and find stolen work.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ebadros account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SDRM_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL (default: https://api.sdrm.io)
